title: Im new here
content: Hello I just watched a video about this and immediately came here as I've been having this dream since I was a kid. Although not as much detail and I never seemed to connect the locations together so much as I thought I was just being transported to a new place although the vibes are always the same feeling I never thought of it as one big location even though I've literally "walked" into the next location. Example I've walked away from the school into the mall before. I'm just wondering if anyone would be willing to message me to talk more in depth as a post with comments section tends to overwhelm me with multiple conversations going on anyway this is so interesting and I'm so intrigued by so many other people having similar dreams of this weird feeling place
